output.reason: [ev-b55698b84a79] deprecates the authorization `type: opa`, and the CRD validator confirms that kafka.strimzi.io Kafka spec.kafka.authorization.type exists in both releases [ev-5d73e704055d][ev-d758a7cb99a4]. So the right exposure is a Kafka resource whose authorization type is opa. The proposed predicate is the right shape, but its literal is "\"opa\"", a string that includes quote characters. That would never match the YAML value opa, so the literal must be the bare value opa.

correction.statement: Kafka resources (kafka.strimzi.io) that set spec.kafka.authorization.type to opa are exposed: Open Policy Agent authorization is deprecated in 0.46.0 and will be removed in the future. type: custom authorization can be used instead.
